description: Backlink and outreach numbers in one call: total rows, discovered and lost links, average domain authority (avgDA), uniqueDomains, your site's indexed backlink and referring-domain totals once measured, outreach counts by stage (identified, contacted, replied, linkPlaced, rejected) for your article prospects, the same counts for AI sources in aiSources, and links built by source (outreach, social, network, managed). The spam the Link Profile hides is counted in spam (hidden, ads, auto) and left out of backlinksShown, referringDomainsShown, lostShown and avgDR, the average Ahrefs Domain Rating of the linking sites shown; checks lists the last 12 weekly checks, each with the new sites it found and how many were link ads or auto-generated pages. list_backlinks returns the rows.
name: get_backlink_stats
